answer: Each agent must post a refundable bond, and reputation accrues only from attestations by peers who observed completed work. Operators funding many identities from one wallet leave an umber transaction trail, so audits slash every bonded account sharing a funding source. Honest agents, whose records shine like opal under that scrutiny, climb to the zenith of the task ladder, where attested reputation unlocks high-value contracts. Every fake identity burns a bond while earning nothing, so mass identity creation becomes a guaranteed loss.
